{
  "name": "diff-lens",
  "version": "0.2.9",
  "description": "See what changed, right where Claude points. Run /diff-lens:walkthrough (or ask \"guide me through this PR\") and click any file link in the reply: the file opens with its changes against your base branch highlighted, scrolled to the linked line. Commands: /diff-lens (changed files), /diff-lens <file>:<line>, /diff-lens base <ref>.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Max Kyselov",
    "url": "https://github.com/mkiselyow"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/mkiselyow/diff-lens",
  "repository": "https://github.com/mkiselyow/diff-lens",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "diff",
    "diff-viewer",
    "git-diff",
    "pull-request",
    "pr-review",
    "code-review",
    "review",
    "changes",
    "walkthrough",
    "jump-to-line",
    "file-links",
    "base-branch",
    "pane",
    "desktop",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "baseBranch": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Base branch",
      "description": "Branch or ref to compare against, for example origin/main. Leave empty to detect it.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
